`SurveillanceDroneSwarm::PA::DroneState::Active`: 2 transitions are enabled at once as completion transitions (no trigger) — the simulator takes `Active -> Fault` (declaration order) and never `Active -> PoweredOff`.

`SurveillanceDroneSwarm::PA::FleetConfiguration::MeshDegraded`: 2 transitions are enabled at once as completion transitions (no trigger) — the simulator takes `MeshDegraded -> FullMesh` (declaration order) and never `MeshDegraded -> MeshPartitioned`.
